title: feat(spec,runtime): the package customizations read lists the arrangements its .custom pair writes
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB9qsP28anD5tWRUHq8j1xSU)_
Fixes #36626
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — #36828 (`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md:129` teaches this read's lists and leaves out `arrangements`; this PR corrects the `content/docs/api/metadata-api.mdx` copy of the same sentence)

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzhpykmQZe1yMupC2CU

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：管理员在已安装应用的记录页调整页签（排序、改名、隐藏）后，读取该应用「定制总览」的接口会列出这项页签排列（字段分组、按钮布局同理）；页面显示不变，原包不变。
- 为什么做：补齐「记录页就地配置页签」留下的缺口，让管理员或工具在定制总览里看得到自己做过的页签排列。
- 出错会怎样：只影响定制总览接口多出的一项清单；旧版本客户端严格校验时会拒收新多出的一项，需随本版本一起升级，可随时撤回本次改动。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

**The widening, for the contract reviewer: one new required member `arrangements` and one new count `counts.arrangements` on `GetPackageCustomizationsResponseSchema`** (`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts`). Nothing existing changes shape.

```ts
arrangements: z.array(z.object({
  object: z.string(),                    // the base-owned object
  key: z.enum(CUSTOM_ARRANGEMENT_KEYS),  // 'fieldGroups' | 'relatedLists' | 'actionLayout'
}).strict()),
counts: { /* … */ arrangements: z.number().int().nonnegative() /* … */ },
```

- **Producer** (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, `readPackageCustomizations`): in the loop that already reads the pair's `extend` contributors for `extensions`, each key the contributor's body writes is listed, through `extensionArrangementKeys` (`@objectstack/spec/data`), the one reading of the frozen key list that the registry fold and the doors' judge also use. One entry per object and key, deduplicated across the base's pairs. Ordered by object, then key in list order. A stored `object_extension` row is registered as that same contributor with its whole parsed body (`registerStoredObjectExtension`), so a tab list the record page saves into the pair is read here.
- **Per-kind entry, not an `extensions` member.** An arrangement is one whole declaration of the object, not a member joining one of its collections, so it gets its own list. Precedent says every list has a count (`contributions` widening), so `counts.arrangements` follows it.
- **Named, not copied.** The entry carries no content. The arrangement is read back with `GET /meta/object_extension/OBJECT?package=BASE.custom`, and nothing is compared with the base.
- **`actionLayout` is included: an accepted deviation from the card's wording.** The card names `relatedLists` and `fieldGroups`. `actionLayout` is the third key of the same frozen list (`CUSTOM_ARRANGEMENT_KEYS`). Listing it is the same single rule: iterate the frozen list. Leaving it out would need a second, hand-written key list.

Rulings followed (quoted, not re-ruled):

- Schema docblock (ADR-0146 D2, D6): "Served rows and ledger rows only: nothing is computed from them but the counts. ⛔ No diff against the base and no `basedOn` verdict." The new list is read from the pair's stored extension. It computes nothing and compares nothing.
- Same docblock: "Strict at every level: a member the door starts serving is a change to this declaration first." The declaration is widened in this PR, strict, before the producer serves the member.
- Ruling 6566915346 letter E: the entry shape is per kind, and nothing is joined by name on the client.

Riders the widening needed:

- Regenerated artefacts: `authorable-surface/api.json`, `content/docs/references/api/package-lifecycle.mdx`, `docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.counts/api.md` (536 to 537).
- Route-ledger note.
- `content/docs/api/metadata-api.mdx`.
- Changeset, `minor` on `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/runtime`. The authorable-surface shard moved (a key added), so `Check Changeset` requires `Metadata-protocol: added`. The claim's `none` was corrected on the card by the seat.
- The full-answer fixtures of 10 `ui/` app-shell tests. The console parses the answer through the strict schema, so a fixture without the new member is refused. This is the same rider the `contributions` widening carried.
- A collection-time side-effect import in 5 of the edited tests. `check:test-source-alias` asks this of every test file a change edits.

Read first, by risk:

1. `packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts`, the `arrangements` member and its count: the contract.
2. `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, `readPackageCustomizations`: the producer hunk and its dedupe.
3. `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-customizations.test.ts`, the new `[#36626]` describe.

## Tests

- New runtime describe (3 cases) in `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-customizations.test.ts`:
  - **Acceptance through the real protocol.** A tab arrangement (two tabs swapped, one hidden) is saved into the pair the way the console's record-page writer saves it: draft save, then per-item publish. The read then lists `[{ object: 'showcase_task', key: 'relatedLists' }]` with `counts.arrangements` 1 and adds no `extensions` member, and it parses through the schema. The base's own declared tab list is unchanged. The served object carries the pair's arrangement (`_relatedListsArrangement.packageId` is the pair), which is the agreement check.
  - **Key removed.** Saving the extension again without the key lists no arrangement.
  - **All three keys.** All three keys are listed in list order, an empty list included. Another package's arrangement and the pair's arrangement of an object the base does not own are not listed.
- New spec describe (6 cases) in `packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.test.ts`:
  - each key parses and is preserved;
  - the enum is exactly `CUSTOM_ARRANGEMENT_KEYS`;
  - a non-arrangement key is refused;
  - an entry carrying content is refused `unrecognized_keys`;
  - `object` and `key` are required;
  - the list and its count are required.
- **Ablation.** Committed first. The mutation went through `ablation-replace.mjs`: `arrangements.push(...)` was replaced, and the anchor count went 1 to 0. Result: 3 of the 3 new runtime cases red, 22 green. The restore was proven by blob equal to HEAD (`5f898d1977`) and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

<details><summary>Runs (local, at head a6e28c2ee; before it b427f6983 for the gate sweep, whose later commit only adds collection-time imports to edited tests)</summary>

- `vitest run` runtime `packages-customizations.test.ts` + `dispatcher-plugin.package-customizations-mount.test.ts`: 2 files, 26/26 passed.
- `vitest run` spec `src/api/package-lifecycle.test.ts`: 63/63 passed.
- `vitest run` the 10 edited `ui/` app-shell tests: 10 files, 110/110 passed.
- `typecheck` spec + runtime: exit 0.
- `check:generated` (spec): 2 stale artefacts found (docs, strictness ledger), regenerated with `--fix`, now clean.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 123 derived families. `--ran` reconciliation: 121 run with exit 0, 2 NOT MEASURED (exit 3, prerequisite):
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`: its fixture is pinned to a commit this shallow clone cannot reach. It gives the same exit 3 on the untouched main checkout.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: it needs the whole workspace built. Declared to CI.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 5127 passed, 2 skipped.
- `check:skill-examples`: first prerequisite-refused because client-react had no `dist/`. After building it: 349 examples type-check, exit 0.
- `check:test-source-alias`: first red on the 5 edited tests. After the prescribed collection-time imports: OK.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The card's HotCRM 「线索」 acceptance is covered by the real-protocol test above, not by a live HotCRM run: the test drives the same draft-save-then-publish into the pair that the record page's writer sends. The runtime and spec packages were not run in full locally; CI's `Test Core` and the type-check lanes carry them.
- The Studio landing's "n customized" number still adds only `counts.overrides` and `counts.extensions`. Whether an arrangement should count there is a console choice this card does not ask for.
- The dedupe across two pairs (the App's pair and a per-package pair that both write one key on one object) is not pinned by a test. Pinning it needs a multi-package App fixture. One entry per object and key is the only meaningful reading of a `{ object, key }` entry.

## Verification

Two minutes: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/packages-customizations.test.ts`. Expect 25 passed, including the three `[#36626]` cases.
